column1: # Black Hole simple mode: six sliders (0..100) that each move several underlying options along
# hand-tuned curves. See docs/CHOOSER-TAXONOMY.md. Columns (tab separated):
#   axis, option, curve, stops, label, description, low word, high word
# An axis row has option "-" and carries label, description and the words shown at the two ends.
# An option row names an option of options/blackhole.tsv, a curve (linear: piecewise linear between the
# stops; step: the value of the last stop at or below the slider) and "position=value" stops; its last
# four columns stay empty and may be omitted (editors strip trailing tabs). Every curve
# must have a stop at 0 and at 100, and its value at 50 must equal the option's schema default, so that
# the centre of every slider is "as shipped" and Reset returns there. tools/generate-catalog.py checks
# all of this and that every value stays inside the option's range (float) or choices (enum).
